name: Maid-san no Iru Kurashi S
original_name: メイドさんのいる暮らしS
source:
This time, the heroine is both a maid and a fiancée—talk about luxury!
Both the protagonist and the heroine have been completely reimagined, so even if you haven’t played the previous game, you can jump right in and enjoy the story without any worries!

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1266324]getchu[/url]]
translation:
这次，女主角既是女仆，又是未婚妻——奢侈啊！
主角和女主角都经过了彻底的重新想象，所以即使你没有玩过前作，你也可以毫无顾虑地直接进入故事！

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1266324]getchu[/url]]
